question: If the simple interest charged for 9 months be 0.12 times the money borrowed, what is the rate percent per year?
solution:
**Given:**

Time = 9 months

SI = 0.12 × Principle 

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

1 year = 12 months

⇒ 1 month = 1/12 years

⇒ 9 months = 9/12 years

According to the question,

SI = 0.12 × P

SI =** **(P × R × T)/100

**⇒** P × 0.12 = (P × 9 × R)/(12 × 100)

⇒ R = (0.12 × 100 × 12)/9

⇒ R = 16% 

**∴ The rate of interest is 16%.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Rate = (SI for 1 Year)/(Principal) × 100

SI for 9 months = 0.12 × P

⇒ 1 month SI = (0.12 × P)/9

⇒ 12 month SI = (0.12 × P × 12)/9

Rate = (0.12 × P × 12)/(9× P) × 100

⇒ Rate = 144/900 × 100 = 16%
